questions.question:
Identify the correct form of the sentence with inversion required for emphasis.

The committee will discuss the proposal tomorrow.

Which of the following sentences correctly inverts the original structure for emphasis?
options: Tomorrow, the proposal will be discussed by the committee.
Tomorrow will the committee discuss the proposal.
Tomorrow, will the committee discuss the proposal?
The committee will discuss the proposal tomorrow, doesn't it?
questions.answer: Tomorrow will the committee discuss the proposal.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly uses a cleft sentence to emphasize the location of the meeting?
options: It is in the conference room that we will hold the meeting.
In the conference room is where we will hold the meeting.
The meeting will be held in the conference room, which is the main building.
Where the meeting will be held is in the conference room.
questions.answer: It is in the conference room that we will hold the meeting.

questions.question:
Select the correct form of the sentence using the third conditional to discuss a hypothetical situation in the past.

If they had known about the strike, they would have reconsidered their travel plans.

Which of the following correctly uses the third conditional?
options: If they had known about the strike, they would have reconsidered their travel plans.
If they knew about the strike, they would have reconsidered their travel plans.
If they would have known about the strike, they would have reconsidered their travel plans.
If they had known about the strike, they would reconsider their travel plans.
questions.answer: If they had known about the strike, they would have reconsidered their travel plans.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a formal recommendation?
options: The committee recommends that all members attend the meeting.
The committee recommends that all members attends the meeting.
The committee recommends that all members attending the meeting.
The committee recommends that all members will attend the meeting.
questions.answer: The committee recommends that all members attend the meeting.

questions.question:
Identify the correct sentence with ellipsis, ensuring grammatical coherence and meaning.

She said that she was going to the party, but he said that he wasn't.

Which of the following correctly uses ellipsis to shorten the sentence while maintaining meaning?
options: She said that she was going to the party, but he said that he wasn't.
She said that she was going to the party, but he said wasn't he.
She said that she was going to the party, but he said he wasn't.
She said that she was going to the party, but he said he wasn't going.
questions.answer: She said that she was going to the party, but he said he wasn't.
